messages.content: 去年現代藝術博物館的會員們有多頻繁地參觀？

function.name: most_frequent_visitor
function.description: Retrieve the visitor who visited the museum the most within a given period. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

start_date.description: The start date of the period, format: yyyy-mm-dd.

end_date.description: The end date of the period, format: yyyy-mm-dd.

minimum_visits.description: The minimum number of visits to qualify. Default: 1

message.content: 請問您想了解的是「會員在去年參觀的平均次數」還是「會員在去年總共參觀了多少次」？另外，請提供您想查詢的博物館的正式名稱。
message.reasoning: The user asks: "去年現代藝術博物館的會員們有多頻繁地參觀？" They want the frequency of visits by members at the modern art museum last year. We have a tool most_frequent_visitor that can retrieve the visitor who visited the museum the most within a given period. But the user wants the frequency of visits by members, not just the most frequent visitor. There's no tool that directly gives the average or total visits by members. We could ask clarifying question: do they want the average visits per member? Or the total visits? Or the most frequent visitor? The user didn't specify a period; we need to clarify the period. Also we need to know if they want the average visits per member or the total visits. So we should ask clarifying question: "您想知道的是會員在去年參觀的平均次數，還是總共參觀了多少次？" Also we need the museum name. The user said "modern art museum" but we need the exact name. So we ask for clarification.
